title: NFT Hunt
tagline: Hunt your favorite NFTs and discuss about them
description: Using NFT Hunt, you can Hunt your favorite NFTs and discuss about them. On the homepage you can see a list of NFTs that have been hunted. For each NFT, you can see the upvote and downvote count. You can also see the list of comments for the NFT. It is powered using React js, Solidity and Matic Testnet.
